dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the Mora that Xingqiu said he'd lend you.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Oh my! As expected of Liyue's great hero — coming in the nick of time to my aid!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *cough* Uh, I mean, considering your long-term partnership with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, just ask me any questions you might have.
